AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.

2. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

5. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.

6. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.

7. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

11. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.

12. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Controls and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Navigation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

3. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.

7. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.

8. C — Information and Communication Technology

9. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. D — CPU

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
